projects.name: Etch
projects.summary: Etch turns one sentence into a real circuit board. You say “build a GPS tracker like an AirTag” and walk away.
projects.crusoe: Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on Crusoe Managed Inference, with NVIDIA's prompt complexity classifier for routing.

projects.name: SPARKLETEAM
projects.summary: SPARKLETEAM is a self-improving agent team that teaches itself to load a dishwasher.
projects.crusoe: Runs five NVIDIA Nemotron models on Crusoe Managed Inference in a live self-improving loop.

projects.name: AGI Factory
projects.summary: AGI Factory is a robot maintenance team that rewrites itself and keeps a change only when unseen factory months prove it better and safer.
projects.crusoe: A self-improving robot maintenance team on Crusoe-hosted Nemotron models; the recorded Crusoe run matches a deterministic local replay.
